verdict.rationale: Lium is a hosted GPU rental marketplace, and self-hosting the platform is a fair question for a SaaS service. Nothing in the evidence shows the core marketplace or API can be deployed on your own infrastructure. The GitHub repo is only the client CLI, and the provider quickstart covers supplying GPU nodes to Lium's marketplace, not running Lium itself, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
